title: Cities & Housing — Consolidation
goal: Integrate tense contrast, verbs of change, prepositional relatives, corrective reframing and narrative pacing in urban discourse
grammar: Unit 16 review: imperfect vs present perfect, verbs of change, prepositional relatives, sino vs pero, narrative time connectors

items: I can contrast historical neighbourhood baselines with ongoing shifts in housing affordability.
I can trace urban transformation with *volverse*, *quedarse*, *convertirse en* and *hacerse*.
I can build precise urban-policy clauses with prepositional relatives and reframe debates with *sino / sino que / pero*.
I can pace past urban change and future policy milestones with *apenas*, *al cabo de*, *conforme* and *en cuanto*.
